svg.title: Tattoo pain chart body diagram
svg.desc: Front and back body diagram colored by how much each tattoo placement hurts. Severe: ribs, spine, sternum, armpit, ankles, shins, hands and feet. High: inner elbow, groin and inner thigh. Moderate-high: inner arm, knee and elbow. Moderate: stomach, shoulder and upper back. Low-moderate: calf. Low: upper arm, outer forearm and outer thigh.
svg.text: Grey areas are not ranked. Pain is subjective: tolerance, artist and session length all shift it.
